title: Mixed units within one table
question: Calculate gross margin for both years and explain the change.

gold_answer.summary: Revenue is stated in GBP m and cost of sales in GBP k, so revenue must be converted (GBP 12,000k and GBP 13,200k) before calculating. Gross margin fell from 40.0% to 38.0%, down 2.0 percentage points, because cost of sales grew 13.7% while revenue grew 10.0%.
gold_answer.main_driver: Cost of sales grew faster than revenue.

design_note: Trap. Tests two things: whether the model converts units correctly (C1), and whether it tells the reader it did so (C5). A response with the right margins that never mentions the unit mismatch fails C5, because the reader cannot tell whether the conversion was deliberate or lucky.
